scoring_justification: Elastic constants and anisotropic Tc are produced by a full DFT+EPW pipeline; recomputing them in the verifier sandbox is infeasible. We compare reported values to the paper's reported targets with tolerances, and enforce monotonic increase of Tc with strain.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for elastic constants and Tc
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text: C11=570 N/m, C22=322, C12=22, C44=146, Ya=569.4, Yb=321.4; Tc zero strain = 20 K (anisotropic ME); Tc 13% strain = 46 K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's main reported results, validated against solve.sh output.

outputs.description: Computed elastic constants and Young's moduli; compared to the paper-reported reference values with a tolerance.
Anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg Tc at zero strain; compared to the paper-reported value within a tolerance.
Anisotropic Tc under 13% tensile strain along a; compared to the paper-reported value and monotonic increase with strain is verified.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are JSON files containing the computed physical quantities. The hidden checker will compare these values against the paper's reported results, using appropriate tolerances to account for implementation differences. The checker will also verify that Tc increases under tensile strain, consistent with the paper's conclusion.

steps.description: Each elastic constant must be within 10% relative error of the paper's value.
Tc at zero strain must be within ±3 K of the paper's 20 K.
Tc at 13% strain must be within ±3 K of the paper's 46 K.
Verify that Tc at 13% strain is greater than Tc at zero strain by at least the margin.
